digest.component_or_area: Jira adapters (Cloud and Data Center reconciler)
propositions: Cloud adapter (ACLI-based, historically battle-tested) and Data Center adapter (pycontribs-based, tested against live Dockerized instance) have divergent test coverage with gaps running in both directions that must be unified for confidence in DC feature

DC adapter's create-path field values, sanitizer boundaries, identity label form, and probe branches must be pinned by value rather than by shape contract alone to match Cloud's incident-hardened safety net

DC comment and description convergence behavior must be characterized across multiple passes with explicit provenance for length limits (WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT tied to jira.text.field.character.limit and JRASERVER-28519)
Duplicated ticket-type map within adapters/ must be single-sourced with regression guard (like existing status and priority maps) to prevent divergence between Cloud and DC execution paths

Vacuous tests that assert only shape without behavioral pinning must either be rewritten to name their actual contract or renamed to reflect what they actually verify, eliminating false confidence markers

Parametrized characterization suite must explicitly assert different expected values for known vendor divergences (ADF vs wiki markup, accountId vs name identity form) rather than asserting sameness across both adapters
